messages:
Lina (CS): Heads-up: client 'KiteLabs' onboarding call — integration is live but theyre seeing early failures. Not classic preflight 429 spike. More like steady 429s after a short lull. Renewal conversation next month; theyre anxious.
Rahul (SDK Eng): Can you paste the sample request pattern? are they using single-page-app polling or webhooks?
Lina (CS): From their dev: 
```
// frontend polling every 2s
setInterval(()=> fetch('/proxy/generate'), 2000)
```
Lina (CS): They also rotate keys every ~12s in their dev flow (for testing) which came up in the replay.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Ok two correlated issues: aggressive short-lived key rotation + tight polling creates a fanout where the proxy loses the client_id binding and the requests fall back to tenant-global rate limits. That looks like 429s for the whole account, not just session.
Rahul (SDK Eng): If their token rotation yields frequent `Authorization` header changes, our handshake cache TTL will miss and we re-run preflight on each rotate. Also if `X-Client-Id` is absent, the system attributes to account bucket.
Lina (CS): snippet from their gateway logs: 
```
[2026-03-21T16:10:01Z] 200 handshake id=hdl1 client_id=slot-3
[2026-03-21T16:10:12Z] 401 handshake id=hdl2 reason=invalid_token
[2026-03-21T16:10:12Z] 429 route=/v1/generate account_bucket=kitelabs
[2026-03-21T16:10:14Z] 429 route=/v1/generate account_bucket=kitelabs
```
Priya (Solutions Eng): Proposed mitigation: 1) advise KiteLabs to stop rotating keys for now and switch to ephemeral tokens with a 60s TTL (or a shared session token). 2) Ensure their proxy sets `X-Client-Id` stable per user session. 3) We can open a temporary account-level grace throttle for 30m and add a console alert.
Ava (AM): I'll notify the renewal stakeholders and offer a technical review session. Can we get the grace window before their next CI run in 15m?
Deploy Bot: action: created entitlement: preflight-grace:kite-labs duration=30m by Priya. Dashboard rule added: alert/onboarding/key-rotate-429s -> customer-success.
Rahul (SDK Eng): Medium-term SDK changes: 1) treat frequent Authorization changes within a 2-minute sliding window as likely test harness — don't force full handshake for first retry attempt. 2) emit client_id auto-generation helper so SPA authors don't omit stable client ids. I'll draft a PR for redwood-sdk-js to add `autoClientId: true` and `rotationToleranceMs: 120000`.
Priya (Solutions Eng): For immediate triage Ill run a server-side patch to relax the handshake cache expiry for kite-labs to 90s; should prevent the repeated preflight churn while we wait on the client patch. Logging will note the override so we revert after stabilization.
Lina (CS): I sent KiteLabs a short runbook: stop rotation, set stable X-Client-Id, and repro steps. Scheduled a check-in in 20m. Also asked them to attach a small HAR so we can confirm headers.
Ava (AM): Thanks team. Ill coordinate the post-mortem and capture feedback items for product: clearer onboarding SDK defaults and a "safe-mode" for dev teams.
Rahul (SDK Eng): Follow-ups: PR and canary for SDK helper (ETA: 48h), server-side handshake TTL tweak (Priya) live in 2m, entitlement active. After changes, monitor the console card for 15m and we'll close if 429s stop.
Lina (CS): closing loop after the call. Will update thread with HAR and final status. :white_check_mark:
